style.backgroundSystem: alternating jet-black stage panels #0A0A0A for drama screens and clean white panels #FFFFFF for info screens; a satin fabric drape reserved for the opening hero only

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of jet-black stage background #0A0A0A, clean white info panels #FFFFFF, brushed aluminum-silver product metal #B9BEC5, one amber-gold accent #D4AF37 for headlines and highlights, and a thin crimson-red accent #C0392B reserved for small divider bars and highlight ticks; high-contrast dual lighting system, dramatic dark-stage key with rim light on black panels and bright even high-key light with soft contact shadows on white panels; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with the top face and glowing blue LED readout facing the camera; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product upright or tilted with the top face and its glowing blue LED readout #4FA3E0 facing the camera, stable centered placement, consistent metallic rendering, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: glossy dark acrylic stage, matte white info panel, sweeping satin fabric drape, matte charcoal-grey flat lay surface #2A2D31
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on white and white or amber-gold #D4AF37 on black, thin crimson divider bars #C0392B, grey sublines in #8A8F94
